description: This PHP file defines the VacancyListRestController class, which handles REST API requests related to vacancy listings within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It primarily processes GET requests to retrieve a list of vacancies with pagination, sorting, and filtering capabilities. The class implements interface methods for HTTP verbs and utilizes traits for vacancy service and normalization services. It includes validation rules for request parameters and handles unimplemented POST, PUT, and DELETE methods by throwing exceptions.

classes.name: VacancyListRestController
classes.description: Controller for handling REST API requests related to vacancy listings in the recruitment module, primarily supporting GET requests to retrieve vacancy data with filtering and sorting options.

methods.name: handleGetRequest
methods.description: Processes GET requests to retrieve a list of vacancies based on query parameters such as offset, limit, and sort order. Returns a normalized array of VacancyModel instances along with total count.

methods.name: handlePostRequest
methods.description: Throws NotImplementedException, indicating POST operation is not supported.

methods.name: handlePutRequest
methods.description: Throws NotImplementedException, indicating PUT operation is not supported.

methods.name: handleDeleteRequest
methods.description: Throws NotImplementedException, indicating DELETE operation is not supported.

methods.name: initGetValidationRule
methods.description: Defines validation rules for GET request parameters such as limit, offset, and sort order.

methods.name: getValidationDecorator
methods.description: Lazy initialization of the ValidationDecorator instance used for request parameter validation.

methods.name: getNotImplementedException
methods.description: Returns a new instance of NotImplementedException used for unsupported HTTP methods.
